scope: the single frozen 162-vertex graph H4; no universal five-cycle-double-cover claim
theorem: Every cardinality-minimum exact-zero matching of an F_2^2-flow on H4 packs two edge-disjoint boundary joins in its complement and therefore extends to a standard five-cycle double cover.
completeness: UNSAT LRAT accepted by lrat-check and CakeML cake_lpr
